description:
遠州のブロッケン, the stage 1 boss theme from 東方水零流 ～ Seven Period Mystical, a Touhou-style music album.

It's your standard fare cheery stage 1 boss theme, and super catchy. It also feels very wet to me. @4 and @1 make a very delicious combination too~

Originally submitted to Superfamicompo 6.
